verdict.rationale: Adyen's POS docs explicitly cover chip/contactless via certified terminals, Tap to Pay on iPhone for contactless mobile acceptance, and global/local payment methods including wallets; PCI PTS certified terminals and offline resilience are documented. missing for 10: explicit named support for Apple Pay/Google Pay wallet acceptance at the terminal (only 'global and local payment methods' is generic) and independent hands-on validation beyond one negative community integration anecdote unrelated to this core capability.
